change: Freeze each request's track-buffer position before the prefill helper advances it; gather physical slot IDs from the existing authoritative GPU mapping. Upload the frozen CPU mask and sequence lengths using fresh per-batch pinned staging.
gate: Batch size at least8; exact static HybridReqToTokenPool with CUDA int64 mapping and request indices; ordinary non-lazy extra_buffer; no speculative, mixed-chunk or dual-snapshot route. All other cases preserve scalar extraction and original uploads.
ownership: Gather materializes a batch-owned tensor on the schedule stream. Fresh pinned tensors are immutable and retained by ScheduleBatch.copy and overlap snapshots; the pinned allocator fences storage reuse. Existing scheduler WAR and forward-stream waits preserve ordering.
validation: 48 synthetic request-batch steps using exact prepare/helper/static allocation/set/donate/free methods passed track/mask/length/request-state equivalence. Copy/filter/merge and two queued staging generations passed. Independent source review matched schedule SHA aa66801d5f33ea5aa2833d61eaa71109bf09e68231dbc1c235d2ac6ac66c4954.
limitations: Request-slot admission, KV location allocation and sampler were mocked; token bodies and slots were synthetic. This is a boundary probe, not TP8/model/TPOT/chain performance. Earlier globally enabled variants regressed B1/B2 and are excluded by the final threshold.
remaining_sync: The Hybrid allocator's two mapping writes with Python-list indices still synchronize. The change does not eliminate complete prefill preparation's wait for previous GPU work.
current_workload: The first250 prefill batches of the current N46 diagnostic contained238 singletons; no global adoption claim follows from these boundary savings.
memory: Fresh pinned mask/length payload9bytes per request; gathered positions use the existing helper. No persistent GPU workspace or KV/state pool resizing.
